EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for your interest in the PhD in applied mathematics
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in the doctoral program in applied mathematics offered by the School of Mathematical and Statistical Sciences at Arizona State University.
Please review the program description for admission and degree requirements and for more details on how to apply. If you have any questions regarding the degree program after reviewing the information above, please contact any of the faculty advisors for applied math:
Steven Baer Zdzislaw Jackiewicz Eric Kostelich
For more general questions about our graduate programs and the application process, please feel free to email me at grad.math@asu.edu. I will be happy to assist you.
Sincerely,
Debbie Olson Graduate Program Coordinator ASU School of Mathematical and Statistical Sciences grad.math@asu.edu
